content: Pol-me Holi Spirit-na puri madaa agaa lakesa
Ame baaninu-ya, nimiri Holi Spirit-na puri adaliminalo lagialo. Go madaare agaa pagalepa.
Abade nimi Gote-na kepo rarane pirisimide raburi wae omape remonumi nimi makiraawa wae pora-para lamua pisimi.
Goa pea-ga waru pagalepa: Gote-na Holi Spirit-mi aa meda pora mea waatea-daare go aame Yesu-para goa napape mada natea. Go page Holi Spirit piri aa medame Yesuri ora Aa Mudu pia mada tea.
Holi Spirit-na puriri rado rado ia pare Holi Spirit nipumi rayo guaaya.
Niaame Aa Mudu-na kogono pua onaa raba mulalo pemare pora rado rado ia-daa Aa Mudu padane raba mealima.
Go page kogono pape kone rado rado ia pare gore padane-ma mere onaa rayo kone guaaya. Goa pea-ga onaanumi nipuna kogono rayo mada palimi.
Holi Spirit-miri nipuna puri onaa rayo padane padane laatapu mea katea-pulu onaanu medaloma raba minalo pea.
E, gore Holi Spirit-mi aa padane puri mapalainaloa go aame onaanu Gote madaa makuaae kone laketa. Aa medame page go Holi Spirit-mi puri kanaloa oyaenuna re adoa onaanu laketea.
Go Holi Spirit padane-mame aa meda puri pane kone rulape kone kata. Goa pua go Holi Spirit-mi aa meda puri kanaloa yaina ome onaanu mada marekaalia.

Holi Spirit-mi puri gupa guaaya: Aa medamere puri pane kogono pape puri meme. Medamere Gote-na epe agaa lakelape puri meme. Medamere puri adoa gupa mada laketea: Go puriri ora Holi Spirit-na puri yapalo mo puri wae remonuna puri yapalo mada laketea. Aa medamere puri mua nipumi abade napage adaa agaa rado mada pagalia. Aa medamere puri mua aba napage adaa agaa radona re mada laketea.
Go-rupa puri muare Holi Spirit padaneme-ga go kogono rayo mea rumaaya. Nipuna kone sua onaanu puri rado rado kalaama pea.
Niaa rayore yogane padane yapare rado rado ma-aulaawa pima
Krais-na tore yogane rado rado-rupa aaya. Go-rupare niaa to yogane padane pirua yapare rugi rado ia. Goa pua Krais-ri ora niaana to yogane padane-rupa pia.

Goa pea-ga niaa rayome Holi Spirit padane misima rabu baptais mua padane ma-aulaaya-daa pima. Niaa Juda aanu-para Grik aanu-para esepene aanu-para kogonome adini aanu-para go Holi Spirit padane mua padane-rupa pima.
Gore niaana to yogane madaa aaya rugiri ora rado rado aaya.
Goa pua nipumi gupa pa tea: Niri ki-daa dia-ga niri to yoganena rugini-daa dia. Go aa-na aare nipu ni tona mada napi teare pinawa-ga nipu yoganena rugi pa aalia.
Go page aaneme gupa lalo: Niri ini-daa dia ya-pulu niri to yoganena rugini-daa dia. Goa tea pare aanere nipu yoganena rugini pa aalia.
Gore yogane rayore ini yaalare akeane agaa mada pagalima ya? Go page yogane rayore ini padane yaalore akea pua mada kaa mealima ya?
Yapare yoganere go-rupadaa dia. Abade Gote-me nipuna raana koneme yoganena rugini padane padane laatapu maasa.
Gore yogane to rayona rugini padane-rupa agu yaalore gore ora to yogane-rupa na-aalia.
Pare go-rupadaa dia. Yoganena rugini rado rado aaya pare ora yogane padane-rupa agu aaya. Go piane Gote-me kone rado rado gisa pare niaa rayo nipuna yogane padane-rupa piruaema.
Goa pea pare inimi ki-para gupa mada nalaketea: Neme ni mada naraba muaye-ga rubalua tea. Go page aalumi aa-para gupa mada nalaketea: Neme ni naraba muaye-ga rubalua.
Go rupa-daa dia, yapare niaame niaana yogane rugini meda puri napata kone ima pare go dia yaliare ora omalima.
Gore niaame niaana to yoganena rugini medaloma madaa yala potema pare medaloma waru suruboa medaloma nasurubema.

Goa pema pare mo epe yoganena rugini medalomare go-rupa nasurubema. Goa pea pare Gote-me yogane rugininu rayo makibumaawa warisa. Go rabu ora epe rugini-daa dia kone ima pare nipumi go ruginu epe kogono kasa.
Nipumi goa pea-pulu yogane madaare ruginina robo-rupa na-aaya. Dia-ga padaneme meda narabuniaaya pare padane-rupa surubolalo aaya.
Goa pea-pulu yoganena rugini padane kedaa pea raburi gore yogane rayo page kedaa pea. Gore yogane rugini medame pedo mealiare yogane rayo page pedo mealimi.
Goa pea-ga nimiri Krais-na yogane padane-rupa aeme pare rugini rado rado pimi-ga Gote-me kogono rado kalo kiritea.

Goa pua lotu ada-para Gote-me onaa medaloma gupiane mapiraasa: Aba ripia aposel onaanu wala laapore Gote-na agaa lakene aa onaanu wala repore tisaanu mapiraasa. Walare nipumi yaina maperekeape onaanu raba meape onaanu nipuna kogono surubape onaanu adaa agaa rado lakene lape onaanu mapiraaya.
Gore nipumi aposel kogono aanu padane agaa lakene aanu padane tisaanu padane-rupa mapiraaya? Go page nipumi onaa rayo napiaa kogono pinalo puri nakata?
Go page nipumi onaa rayore yaina ome onaa maperekeape puri nakata? Go page nipumi onaa rayo adaa agaa rado laminalo puri nakata. Go page nipumi onaa rayo agaa radonuna re mada perekenalo puri nakata.
Goa pisa-ga nimimi kone waru sua ora aa muduna agaa puri mulalo pipape. Goa pea pare abiare go kone madaare neme nimi ora epe pora meda abia mea waatoa.
